meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户要求跟踪长期目标时,Claude 会创建、查看、更新目标记录;标记完成前会把目标拆成交付物、逐项核对真实证据,确认无遗留才标完成,否则继续或标为预算耗尽。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设置、继续、审计、暂停、恢复、完成或检查某个长期目标时触发;已有活动目标时也会使用。

say.text: 帮我建一个目标:完成 pi-goal 扩展,预算 50000 token。
say.note: 会调用 create_goal 创建目标记录。

say.text: 查一下当前目标进行到哪一步了。
say.note: 会调用 get_goal 查看目标。

say.text: 这个目标已经全部做完,标成完成。
say.note: 会先核查实际状态,满足条件才 update_goal。

howto.what_en: When asked to track a long-term goal, Claude creates, inspects, or updates a goal record. Before completion it restates the goal as deliverables, checks real evidence, and only marks complete when no work remains.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal; also used when an active goal already exists.

say_en.text: Create a goal: ship the pi-goal extension with a 50000 token budget.
say_en.note: Calls create_goal to record the goal.

say_en.text: Show me the current state of my goal.

say_en.note: Audits actual state first, then calls update_goal.
